Plugin.Command.Help: Opens the GoblinTweaks window. Use "/goblintweaks settings" for the settings.
Window.Subtitle: {0} of {1} tweaks enabled
Window.Welcome.Title: Welcome to GoblinTweaks!
Window.Welcome.Text: Every tweak starts disabled. Turn on the ones you want with their switch; changes apply instantly and are remembered.
Window.Status.ErrorHint: This tweak stopped to protect the game. Details are in /xllog.
Tweaks.RecipeListCompletionMarks.Name: Recipe List completion marks
Tweaks.RecipeListCompletionMarks.Descrip: Shows the Crafting Log check mark next to every recipe in the "Recipes List" window that you have already crafted.
Tweaks.RecipeListCompletionMarks.AnyClas: If an item can be crafted by several classes, mark it when you crafted it with any of them, not only with the class of its section.
Settings.Title: GoblinTweaks settings
Settings.Language.Help: Language of the GoblinTweaks windows. The search finds tweaks in every language.
Tweaks.CraftingMaterials.Name: Crafting Materials Inventory
Tweaks.CraftingMaterials.Description: Shows all craftable recipes cross-referenced with your inventories, saddlebag, retainers and FC chest.
Tweaks.CraftingMaterials.Language.Help: Language for item and recipe names shown in this window. Independent of the GoblinTweaks language; defaults to it.
Tweaks.CraftingMaterials.IncludeRetainer: Retainer data is cached after visiting the retainer bell. May be incomplete if retainers have not been visited this session.
Reads from the FC chest if it was opened this session and you have withdrawal permissions.
CraftingMaterials.Title: Crafting Materials
